description: This file is a shell script used to test parsing and handling of commit and tag messages with CRLF line endings in a Git repository. It defines functions to create references with CRLF line endings, tests for correct message parsing and display, and automates verification of Git command outputs with CRLF messages.

methods.name: create_crlf_ref
methods.description: Creates a Git reference (branch and tag) with a message containing CRLF line endings.

methods.name: create_crlf_refs
methods.description: Creates multiple CRLF-encoded references for testing.

methods.name: test_crlf_subject_body_and_contents
methods.description: Runs a series of tests to verify Git commands correctly handle commit and tag messages with CRLF line endings.
